summary: 68-year-old male from Loveland killed in an ~400-500 ft uncontrolled slide on the Sundance Mountain snowfield (north aspect, between Trail Ridge Road and Old Fall River Road) into rocks; he was wearing a helmet and skiing alone; bystanders witnessed the fall, tried to render aid and notified the park; Northern Colorado Interagency Helitack flew the body to an Upper Beaver Meadows helispot late Sunday afternoon; transferred to the Larimer County Coroner
location: Sundance Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park; Northern Colorado Interagency Helitack
notes: RMNP News Release June-13-2021 via the Rocky Mountain Day Hikes June-2021 archive (opened 2026-09-13); slide-type coded fall per the id-2309 convention.
